parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: MAC address of remote HomePlug device. It is used to uniquely identify and easily correlate with the connected remote HomePlug device.

parameters.name: TxPhyRate
parameters.description: The PHY transmit Rate (expressed in {{units}}) to this remote device.

parameters.name: RxPhyRate
parameters.description: The PHY receive Rate (expressed in {{units}}) from this remote device.

parameters.name: SNRPerTone
parameters.description: {{list}} List items indicate Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) per tone from this remote device (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: AvgAttenuation
parameters.description: Average attenuation from this remote device (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: EndStationMACs
parameters.description: {{list}} List items represent MAC addresses of end stations bridged by the remote HomePlug device. For example: "11:22:33:AA:BB:CC, 22:33:44:DD:EE:66"

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Whether or not this device is currently present in the HomePlug network. The ability to list inactive nodes is OPTIONAL. If the CPE includes inactive nodes in this table, {{param}} MUST be set to {{false}} for each inactive node. The length of time an inactive node remains listed in this table is a local matter to the CPE.

object.description: This table contains information about other HomePlug devices connected to this HomePlug interface.
